messages.subject: Efficient way for the data formatting
parts:
Greetings!

My name is TIgran, and I am an itermediate level R user new to unmarked. I have a dataset based on  ~ 20 repeated observations of 3 species at 16 sites, with 11 site level, and 10 date level co-variates. Our data is in access database, and I was oroginally hoping to produce a single cross-tabulated query to use with unmarked, but then I realized that the data-frame structure is different from, what I thought It was going to be. 

I read through the web site of DJ McNeil (https://darinjmcneil.weebly.com/occupancy-data-preparation.html), and could use this stepwise process to reogranize my data, but I would appreciate any suggestions on more efficient data-preparation process for this purposes, to somehow automate preparation of 

Thanks,

Tigran
